_comment: High/critical advisories with no fix inside Next 14.x (fixes require a major upgrade to Next 15.5+/16). Each entry states why it is not exploitable here. Re-review when upgrading Next. Any advisory NOT listed fails CI.

advisories.GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw: Image Optimization API RCE (SVG): next.config sets images.unoptimized=true and the app never uses next/image, so /_next/image is not served.
advisories.GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4: Image Optimization API RCE (AVIF): same mitigation as above (optimizer disabled).
advisories.GHSA-p293-qw3h-jr36: Windows-hosted servers only; production runs in a Linux container (python:3.11-slim).
advisories.GHSA-36qx-fr4f-26g5: Pages Router + i18n only; the app uses the App Router and has no i18n config.
advisories.GHSA-89xv-2m56-2m9x: Server Actions on custom servers; the app defines no Server Actions and uses the stock standalone server.
advisories.GHSA-m99w-x7hq-7vfj: Server Actions DoS; the app defines no Server Actions.
advisories.GHSA-p3m5-59mp-jv5r: Server Actions DoS; the app defines no Server Actions.
advisories.GHSA-c4j6-fc7j-m34r: SSRF via WebSocket upgrades; the app has no WebSocket routes and rewrites only to a fixed loopback backend.
advisories.GHSA-p9j2-gv94-2wf4: SSRF via attacker-controlled rewrite destination host; all rewrite destinations are a constant BACKEND_ORIGIN (127.0.0.1:8000), never request-derived.
advisories.GHSA-8h8q-6873-q5fj: RSC DoS: availability-only. All pages are client components fed by the JSON API; Cloud Run restarts unhealthy containers (start.sh exits on child death).
advisories.GHSA-q4gf-8mx6-v5v3: RSC DoS: availability-only, same rationale as GHSA-8h8q-6873-q5fj.
advisories.GHSA-h25m-26qc-wcjf: RSC request deserialization DoS: availability-only, same rationale; no Server Functions are exposed.
advisories.GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q: PostCSS (bundled in next) only processes first-party CSS at build time; no attacker-controlled CSS or sourceMappingURL is ever parsed.
advisories.GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849: PostCSS build-time only, same rationale as GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q.
advisories.GHSA-5j98-mcp5-4vw2: glob CLI -c/--cmd injection; glob is a dev-only transitive of eslint-config-next and its CLI is never invoked.
